headline: Arcotech Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure by Arvind Kumar Saraf under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Arvind Kumar Saraf filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 with the NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition or imminent acquisition event in Arcotech Limited.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE on or around 19 June 2026. Under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, a person who has acquired shares or voting rights such that they are likely to acquire control or 25% or more of voting shares must disclose within the stipulated timeline. This filing indicates either a direct substantial acquisition by Saraf or an announcement of intent to acquire. The specific shareholding percentage, offer price and offer period remain to be disclosed in the formal takeover announcement document.
